title: Nebraska Senate Candidate Criticizes Trump Voters in Leaked Recording
summary: A leaked audio recording features Nebraska Senate candidate Dan Osborn criticizing some voters who support former President Donald Trump. In the recording, Osborn is heard saying that the lives of some Trump voters "probably suck." He later explained his remarks, stating, "We're all angry right now." The candidate has since apologized for his comments.
summary_points: Nebraska Senate candidate Dan Osborn was recorded criticizing some Trump voters.
In the recording, Osborn stated that the lives of some Trump supporters "probably suck."
Osborn later explained his remarks by saying, "We're all angry right now."
The candidate has issued an apology for his comments.
